Manages full match flow with simulated opponents.

On-device speech-to-text using SFSpeechRecognizer for Knowledge Bowl oral rounds

UnaMentis
TTS adapter for Knowledge Bowl that respects user's global TTS provider setting

UnaMentis
Service for fetching Knowledge Bowl packs from the management API.

UnaMentis
Question loading, filtering, and selection engine for Knowledge Bowl

UnaMentis
Rebound training simulator for Knowledge Bowl.
Simulates opponent buzzing and missing, training students
to capitalize on rebound opportunities.

UnaMentis
Session lifecycle management for Knowledge Bowl
Extracted from view models for better separation of concerns

UnaMentis
Local session persistence for Knowledge Bowl
On-device storage using JSON files

UnaMentis
Transforms questions from various formats into Knowledge Bowl format.
Implements QuestionTransformer protocol for cross-module question sharing.

UnaMentis
Domain-specific synonym dictionaries for Knowledge Bowl answer validation
Handles common abbreviations and alternative names
